sys_di_key.description:
Extract the total Interest Expense paid or accrued during the year.
This field may appear under any of these labels: - Interest, Interest Expense, Interest Paid - Interest on Bank Overdraft, Interest on OD - Bank Interest for Term Loan A/c, Interest on Term Loan - Interest on Secured Loans, Interest on Unsecured Loans - Finance Charges, Bank Interest, Finance Cost - Interest u/s 234 ABC (this is income tax interest — EXCLUDE this) - Interest on capital (in partnership firms — this is partner remuneration, EXCLUDE this)
Rules: - SUM all bank/loan interest lines together - EXCLUDE: interest on capital to partners, interest on delayed tax payments (u/s 234) - EXCLUDE: interest income received (that is other income, not expense) - Return plain number only. If not found, return: NA
sys_di_key.name: Interest Expense
